decisions.quote: This study presents a systematic replication of Kim, Shaver, and Funk's (2022) novel framework for measuring the dynamics of industry clusters. Nine independent research teams comprising doctoral students and faculty mentors conducted independent reproductions, exact replications, and constructive replications across multiple industries and an extended timeframe (1974-2022). Our reproductions and exact replications validate the original findings reported by Kim et al. (2022) for the semiconductor industry, confirming the reliability of the measurement framework.
